summary: Wrote a four-phase plan separating verify-deploy.sh's invocation-CWD axis from its TARGET-argument axis: a new TARGET_REPO CONTRACT header paragraph plus a usage-line subsection (outcomes 1-2), one added gate0 stderr line (outcome 3), and a companion-docs phase that widens regeneration-is-manual-only.md's existing pointer by one clause rather than duplicating the contract (outcome 4, decided as header-alone authority). Planning established two facts the research report lacked: context/formats/plan-format.md:364 is the actual origin of the cited defect, carrying a verbatim copy-pasteable --only-gate 3,4 <source_dir> invocation that was reproduced failing with exit 2, so correcting it is folded into phase 3; and gate 3 (doc-lint) already FAILS at baseline from pre-existing deploy staleness, so every phase verifies differentially against a captured --findings baseline plus an explicit exit-status check. No behavioral change to any gate's pass/fail semantics (outcome 5).
